title: Cockroaches

cji_quote.text: There are youngsters like cockroaches, who don't get any employment and don't have any place in profession. Some of them become media, some of them become social media, some of them become RTI activists, some of them become other activists, and they start attacking everyone.
cji_quote.speaker: Surya Kant, Chief Justice of India
cji_quote.source_status: Vali confirmed the source wording 2026-11-12. Web check 2026-11-12: The News Minute (16 May, citing LiveLaw; free to read) prints 'in profession' where D7 had 'in the profession'; otherwise word for word. Free Press Journal and Scroll print a shorter variant; Bar and Bench paraphrases ('parasites in society') and must not be cited for the verbatim text.
cji_quote.d7_text_variant: don't have any place in the profession

context_facts.text: A CJI Surya Kant–led bench, hearing a contempt plea about senior-advocate designation, compared some unemployed youth who turn to media, social media and RTI activism to “cockroaches” and “parasites”.

links.title: Cockroach Janta Party vs National Parasitic Front: Viral battle
links.snippet: CJI Surya Kant 'reportedly compared certain jobless youth to cockroaches and parasites'

web_notes: dainikjagranmpcg: PARTIAL: confirms the cockroaches/parasites remark; page does not mention the contempt plea about senior-advocate designation. A Jagran search summary (not fetched) said the remark came at a 15 May hearing. Treat as weak.

context_facts.text: Kant later said he had been misquoted and was referring to people with fake degrees.

links.title: Cockroach Janta Party - Wikipedia
links.snippet: his remarks had been misquoted and that he was specifically criticising individuals

context_facts.text: “I am pained to read how a section of the media has misquoted my oral observations made during the hearing of a frivolous case yesterday. What I had specifically criticised were those who have entered professions like the Bar (legal profession) with the aid of fake and bogus degrees. Similar persons have sneaked into the media, social media, and other noble professions as well, and hence, they are like parasites,” ... “It is totally baseless to suggest that I criticised the youth of our nation. Not only am I proud of our present and future human resource, but every youth of India inspires me.”
context_facts.note: Verbatim from LiveLaw, 16 May (read from the page HTML). The '...' is LiveLaw's own elision between two passages. page 0 = not from the dossier.
